functions.purpose: TDR text (human-readable) serializer for the full player item-container struct: store sizes, bag/equip/storehouse item blobs, and the item-use-once list. Iterates each variable-length array formatting one byte per element (via FUN_1010c010). This is the single most important struct in the chunk because it embeds every container capacity cap.
functions.serverRelevance: validation - client-side TdrText formatter, but the array-size caps it enforces mirror the authoritative TDR schema bounds the server MUST enforce when parsing the binary container. Rebuild server should reject packets exceeding these caps.
formulas: field [iBagSize] = int @ *(param_1+3) (offset 6); if iBagSize < 0 return -6; if iBagSize > 82000 return -7
[szBagItem] = byte[iBagSize] starting at (int)param_1 + 10 (offset 0xa), one byte per element
field [wEquipSize] = u16 @ param_1[0xa02d] (offset 0x1405a); if wEquipSize > 0x1000 (4096) return -7
field [iStoreDataSize] = int @ *(param_1+0xa82e) (offset 0x1505c); if iStoreDataSize < 0 return -6; if iStoreDataSize > 200000 return -7
field [wItemUseOnceCount] = u16 @ param_1[0x22ed0] (offset 0x45da0); if wItemUseOnceCount > 200 return -7
costs: TDR error codes: -6 = negative/invalid size, -7 = array size exceeds max
functions.notes: Field order/names cross-check with recovered TlvStoreSizes (storeSize/normalSize/materialStoreSize) and TlvStoreData. The szBagItem/szEquipItem/szStoreItem are size-prefixed byte blobs holding the packed item records; the count field is a byte/int count of blob bytes, not item count.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a player-entity appearance/spawn struct: playerId, netObjId, name, gender, position (sub-struct FUN_10277cf0), rotation (FUN_102780d0), scale, connect flags, sendSrvId, equipmentPack blob, avatarSetID.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (debug text formatter); struct layout is authoritative for the spawn/appearance packet
functions.notes: szEquipmentPack at +0x51 is the worn-equipment appearance blob broadcast to other clients.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a small item-slot-result struct: bItemColumn (u8), wItemGrid (u16), iResult (int).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; layout is the item-slot response
functions.notes: bItemColumn = inventory tab/column index; wItemGrid = grid cell within tab. Recurring (column,grid) addressing pair across all item packets.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: dwItemType (u32), bItemColumn (u8), wItemGrid (u16), then nested item-data sub-struct via FUN_102741f0.
TDR text serializer for ullItemID (u64), bItemColumn (u8), wItemGrid (u16). Base 'item at a slot' identity triple used by many item ops.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; layout is the canonical item-locator (id+column+grid)
functions.notes: This 13-byte {u64 id, u8 column, u16 grid} locator is the recurring primitive; server validates id matches the item actually at (column,grid).

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a move-item request: item locator (id/column/grid) + destination (bDstColumn u8, wDstGrid u16).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; the request is server-authoritative (server validates dst slot free/valid)
functions.notes: Duplicate layout shared with FUN_10329e00 / FUN_10353930.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer identical in layout to FUN_10329a30 (item locator + dst column/grid). Second move-variant packet (e.g. storehouse move vs bag move).

TDR text serializer for a swap-item request: source item locator (ullSrcItemID/column/grid) + destination item locator (ullDstItemID/bDstColumn/wDstGrid). Both endpoints carry item IDs, distinguishing swap from move.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; server authoritative over the swap

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer, same 21-byte layout as FUN_1032a200 but first id labelled [ullItemID] (not SrcItemID) + [ullDstItemID]. Swap variant.
functions.notes: Byte-identical to FUN_1032b2e0 and FUN_10353d30.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer, byte-identical to FUN_1032aec0 (item locator + dst item locator). Third swap-variant packet.
TDR text serializer for a split/partial-move request: item locator + wItemCount + destination column/grid + ullDstItemID. Presence of wItemCount indicates a stack split into a destination stack.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; server authoritative over split (validates count <= source stack size)

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: item locator + wItemCount + dst column/grid (no ullDstItemID, i.e. split into empty slot).
TDR text serializer for a single item-location-with-count element: id/column/grid + wItemCount. Used as the array element type by the tidy/batch serializers (FUN_1032cfa0/1032d540).
functions.notes: Identical layout to FUN_1032de70, FUN_1034ac50, FUN_103eeed0.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for an inventory tidy/sort request: bItemColumn, begin/end grid range, wItemCount, plus four operation sequence counters (iMoveSeq, iSwapSeq, iAddSeq, iDelSeq), then a variable array astItemLocList of item-loc-count elements (FUN_1032bf20).
functions.serverRelevance: validation - client formatter; server enforces the astItemLocList <= 2000 cap and applies the authoritative tidy result
costs: astItemLocList cap: 2000 entries; error -7 on overflow
functions.notes: iMoveSeq/iSwapSeq/iAddSeq/iDelSeq are per-op sequence numbers used to reconcile client/server tidy ordering.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: bItemColumn + begin/end grid + wItemCount + astItemLocList array (FUN_1032bf20). Simpler variant of FUN_1032cfa0 without the seq counters.
TDR text serializer for a use-item request: item locator + three generic dwParam1/2/3 args + szExtParam string. This is the parameterized item-use packet (params depend on item type).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; item-use effect is server-authoritative

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: item locator + wItemCount (e.g. discard/sell-N request). Same layout as FUN_1032bf20.
TDR text serializer: item locator + wItemCount; array element type for FUN_1034b540 / FUN_10354210.
TDR text serializer: bItemColumn + begin/end grid + wItemCount + astItemLocList (FUN_1034ac50), cap 1000 (half of the tidy variants).
TDR text serializer: item locator + wReason (u16). Likely a discard/destroy with reason-code packet.
TDR text serializer: item locator + dst column/grid; byte-identical to FUN_10329a30 (move variant).
TDR text serializer: item locator + dst item locator; byte-identical to FUN_1032aec0/1032b2e0 (swap variant).
TDR text serializer: bItemColumn + begin/end grid + wItemCount + astItemLocList (FUN_1034ac50), cap 1000. Byte-identical to FUN_1034b540.
TDR text serializer for the bare 13-byte item locator (id/column/grid) with no extra fields. Base request for single-item ops.
functions.notes: Same layout as FUN_10329240, FUN_103f1500.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a response: iErrCode (int) prefix + item locator. Generic error-code + locator reply.
functions.notes: Same layout as FUN_103ea2e0, FUN_103f1870 (iErrCode + locator).

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: item locator + iCreditItemCnt (int) + iGoalLevel (int). Item enhancement/upgrade request specifying number of credit/material items consumed and the target level.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; upgrade result (cost, success) is server-authoritative
costs: iCreditItemCnt = count of material/credit items consumed for the upgrade; iGoalLevel = target enhance level

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: iErrCode + item locator. Byte-identical to FUN_103e9bb0.

TDR text serializer for an attribute-transfer request: wTransferAttr, wTransferType, source item locator (ullSrcItemID/column/grid) + destination item locator. Moves an attribute/enchant from one item to another.
TDR text serializer for the attribute-transfer response: iErrCode + wTransferAttr + wTransferType + src/dst item locators. Response counterpart of FUN_103ea6e0.
TDR text serializer for an item combine/craft request: item locator + iDstItemID (resulting item) + iCreditItemCnt + bTagItemCnt (u8) + astTagItemData array (FUN_10272300), cap 6 tag items.
functions.serverRelevance: validation - astTagItemData <= 6 enforced; combine result server-authoritative
costs: Tag-item list cap: 6 entries; error -7. iCreditItemCnt = materials consumed.
functions.notes: Byte-identical to FUN_1041bfe0.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for a response: iRetCode + iErrArg1 + item locator. Two-code error reply with one argument.
functions.notes: Same layout as FUN_1041c440.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer: item locator + wItemCount. Same layout as FUN_1032bf20/1032de70.
TDR text serializer for a dye/recolor request: item locator + iColorIndex (int). Applies a color index to an equipment item.
TDR text serializer for the dye response: iRetCode + item locator + iColorIndex.
TDR text serializer for the bare item locator (id/column/grid). Same as FUN_103e9840.
TDR text serializer: iErrCode + item locator. Same as FUN_103e9bb0/103ea2e0.
TDR text serializer for a beast/pet item op: iSrcBeast, iDstBeast, iUseItem (all int). Uses an item to act on/transfer between two beasts (e.g. feed/transfer).
functions.notes: 'Beast' likely refers to a mount/pet monster; iUseItem is the consumed item id.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for item combine/craft: item locator + iDstItemID + iCreditItemCnt + bTagItemCnt + astTagItemData (FUN_10272300), cap 6. Byte-identical to FUN_103edf50.
TDR text serializer: iRetCode + iErrArg1 + item locator. Byte-identical to FUN_103ee3b0.

Builds the pet-equipment list VO array and pushes it to Flash/Scaleform UI. For each equip slot record (0x40-byte stride) fills asset, collumn, m_bUseItem, isBind, m_nBindType, then calls RefreshPetEquipsUI on the UI.
formulas: asset = rec[0xb]; collumn = rec[2]; m_bUseItem = (rec[0xd] > 0); bindType field(0x11dbfe78) = rec[1]; isBind = (char)rec[0xe]; m_nBindType = rec[0xf]
functions.notes: PETEQUIPITEMVO_CLASS_NAME is the Scaleform VO class.

functions.purpose: Config-table row lookup for CItemBoxInfo (item-box/loot-box definitions) by record id. Standard CInfoManager 2D-array lookup: resolves the singleton manager (lazily creating a default if FindByName fails), then indexes.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only config read; the data table itself is authoritative content shared with server
formulas: mgr = *CItemBoxInfo::GetInfoManager(); if null -> CInfoManager::FindByName('CItemBoxInfo') else default &DAT_123be650
id -= mgr[0x30] (base id); valid iff id>=0 && id<mgr[0x24] (count) && mgr[0x28] (stride)!=0
row = mgr[0x20][id / mgr[0x28]]; return row[id % mgr[0x28]]  (chunked 2D storage)
functions.notes: Same lookup pattern repeated for all *Info tables in this chunk.

functions.purpose: Config-table row lookup for CItemBoxGroupInfo (item-box group definitions) by id; identical 2D-array pattern to FUN_1052c520.
formulas: id -= mgr[0x30]; valid iff 0<=id<mgr[0x24] && mgr[0x28]!=0; row=mgr[0x20][id/mgr[0x28]]; return row[id%mgr[0x28]]
functions.notes: Default fallback &DAT_123be614.

functions.purpose: Config-table lookup for CExpandInventorySlotInfo (bag-slot expansion tiers/costs) by id. Defines how bag capacity can be expanded. Same 2D-array pattern.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only config read; expansion costs/limits are authoritative content
formulas: id -= mgr[0x30]; valid iff 0<=id<mgr[0x24] && mgr[0x28]!=0; row=mgr[0x20][id/mgr[0x28]]; return row[id%mgr[0x28]]
costs: Row content (not read here) holds inventory-slot expansion cost/limit per tier
functions.notes: Default fallback &DAT_123c7970. Directly relevant to bag capacity expansion mechanic.

functions.purpose: Config-table lookup for CExpandStoreHouseSlotInfo (storehouse-slot expansion tiers/costs) by id; identical 2D-array pattern.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only config read; storehouse expansion costs/limits are authoritative content
formulas: id -= mgr[0x30]; valid iff 0<=id<mgr[0x24] && mgr[0x28]!=0; row=mgr[0x20][id/mgr[0x28]]; return row[id%mgr[0x28]]
costs: Row content holds storehouse-slot expansion cost/limit per tier
functions.notes: Default fallback &DAT_123c790c.

functions.purpose: Populates the hunter-group (guild) shared-inventory UI VO: inHunterGroup flag, m_Fund, inventoryRight array (7 rights entries), isHunterLeader, title, m_leaderName, and registers updataSelfCallBack. Only builds detailed fields when player is in a hunter group.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI); the rights/fund values are server-authoritative and merely displayed
formulas: inventoryRight[] loop i in 0..6 (7 entries): value = FUN_116294f0() wrapped as VO type 3
functions.notes: Guild/hunter-group shared inventory permissions surface.

functions.purpose: Dispatch for special client-side item-use actions keyed by an item action code (0x44, 0xee, 0x7f, 0x10f, 0xf5): checks group/quest/wardrobe preconditions and either shows an error dialog (FUN_104ef270 with code) or grants an activity reward (GrantActivityReward) / enters wardrobe. Includes NORMAL_IDLE_WARDROBE gate.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (precondition UI gating); actual reward grant is a server request
formulas: only runs when in_stack_00000014 == 1 and (state&0x8f) in {3,4}
action 0x44: needs group leader; if group fund count>0 -> GrantActivityReward(0xca7); else error code 0x43
action 0xee: wardrobe check -> GrantActivityReward(0x1bd9) else FUN_105eb980
action 0x7f: group check; fund>0 -> reward 0xca7; else -> reward 0x74f
functions.notes: Reward IDs index CActivityReward content; error dialog codes (0x43 etc.) are UI message ids.

functions.purpose: Registers the inventory UI command handlers (GetDataInit, SwapInventoryItem, SplitInventoryItem, TidyInventoryItem, RightClickItem, DiscardInventoryItem, InterSwapItem, TidyAllInventoryItem, MoveOutItem, EditTabName), binding each command string to a handler function pointer (FUN_10944dc0, FUN_10944f40, ...).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI command routing); the operations map to server-authoritative requests
formulas: handler bindings: SwapInventoryItem->FUN_10944dc0, SplitInventoryItem->FUN_10944f40, TidyInventoryItem->FUN_109450b0, RightClickItem->FUN_10945160, DiscardInventoryItem->FUN_10945280, InterSwapItem->FUN_10945350, TidyAllInventoryItem->FUN_10945060, MoveOutItem->FUN_10944be0, EditTabName->FUN_10944aa0
functions.notes: Enumerates the full client inventory action set; use handler names to map to the Tlv request serializers above.

functions.purpose: Registers wardrobe UI -> game (C2AS) command handlers: C2AS_EnterWardrobeState, C2AS_LeaveWardrobeState, C2AS_GetFashionDataArray (FUN_109e7dd0), C2AS_TryOn (FUN_109e80c0), C2AS_ChangePose (FUN_109e8230).
formulas: C2AS_GetFashionDataArray -> FUN_109e7dd0; C2AS_TryOn -> FUN_109e80c0; C2AS_ChangePose -> FUN_109e8230

functions.purpose: Builds the fashion-data array for the wardrobe UI (C2AS_GetFashionDataArray). Iterates the player's wardrobe fashion records (mode 4/5) and, for each, emits a FashionData VO (FUN_109e8440) plus a nested SuitFashionDataArray of the suit's component pieces looked up in CWardrobeInfo.
formulas: gated on param_5==2 and arg types (state&0x8f) in {3,4}
iterates wardrobe list; skips records where rec[10] byte != 0 (hidden)
per component: CWardrobeInfo::GetRecordById lookup (same 2D pattern: id-=[0x30]; row=[0x20][id/[0x28]]; elem=row[id%[0x28]])
functions.notes: SuitFashionDataArray = component pieces belonging to a suit fashion.

functions.purpose: Builds the list of wardrobe fashion records the player owns by iterating CWardrobeInfo table entries (count from vtbl+0x28) and appending each record whose model resolves. Lazily initializes the CWardrobeInfo manager default instance if missing.
formulas: count = mgr vtbl(+0x28); for i in 0..count-1: rec = mgr[0x14][i]; append if model type in {4,5}
table bounds check: i valid iff i>=0 && i < (mgr[0x18]-mgr[0x14])>>2
functions.notes: Writes result count/anchor at param_1+0x50.

functions.purpose: Builds a single FashionData Scaleform VO (mh.view.Wardrobe.Data.FashionData): ItemId, MartId, HasItem, SecondType, ThirdType, ItemIcon, MaleIcon, FemaleIcon, Score. HasItem computed from an inventory presence check (FUN_113fa380).
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (UI VO); HasItem reflects server-owned inventory
functions.notes: MartId links fashion to a cash-shop (Mart) commodity.

functions.purpose: Sets the local player model into the wardrobe idle state: flags byte +0x2405 = 1 and plays the NORMAL_IDLE_WARDROBE animation via CInfoRecord::GetModelString + FUN_10fd7800.
Returns the CWardrobeInfo config manager singleton, lazily creating a default (&DAT_123c911c) and initializing (FUN_109e9840) if the named manager is not found. Helper used by the wardrobe lookups.
formulas: mgr = *CWardrobeInfo::GetManager(); if null -> FindByName('CWardrobeInfo'); if still null -> default &DAT_123c911c (init once via flag DAT_123c9118&1)

functions.purpose: Destructor/teardown for the CryEngine player game-object 'Inventory' extension: releases the 'Inventory'/'Interactor'/'AnimatedCharacter' game-object slots, unbinds many held references and animated-character resources, and restores base vtables. Stock CryEngine game-object-extension plumbing (IInventory), not the bag/item container.
formulas: many member-pointer teardowns at param_1[...] offsets; ref-count free pattern (idx-0xc header, FUN_10c3dad0/FUN_10c3d900)
functions.notes: This 'Inventory' is CryEngine's actor-equipment/weapon inventory extension, distinct from the MHO bag/store container.

functions.purpose: Lazily acquires the 'Inventory' game-object extension (mode 2 = acquire) for an actor and caches it at +0x3c. CryEngine plumbing.

Initializes the player Inventory game-object extension: binds parent game object, enables/updates AnimatedCharacter and Inventory slots, registers with the actor system, caches globals. Stock CryEngine init. Terminates in a not-return error path (FUN_10c3d580) if a subcheck fails.
formulas: sets physics/update flags via vtbl calls

functions.purpose: Post-init / hand-off of the Inventory extension to a new owner: copies the +0x4d7 handle, re-acquires 'Inventory' slot, syncs AnimatedCharacter, sets update flags. CryEngine plumbing.

Resets the player Inventory extension on (re)spawn/revive: releases Inventory/Interactor slots, resets transform/scale members (identity 0x3f800000), reloads hitpart data (hitpartParams, HitPartSetting), gameParams, fires OnRevive. Largely CryEngine actor plumbing; touches worn-equipment appearance but not bag contents.
formulas: resets members +0x4d9.. with identity scale 0x3f800000 (1.0f) at +0x4de and +0x4e2
functions.notes: param_2 flag controls whether appearance is re-applied (FUN_10ba9b00 path).

functions.purpose: Releases the 'Inventory' (+0x3c) and 'Interactor' (+0x40) game-object extension slots (mode 3 = release) and clears the cached handles. CryEngine plumbing.

Validates a use-item-on-world-target interaction: reads ItemID from the interaction params, checks the target object is the expected type (==2) and shares the same class id (vtbl+0x88) as the actor's inventory-held object, then flags ItemUsed and triggers the use (FUN_1025bd00 / FUN_10262a50). Returns 0 on success, 0xffffffff on failure.
functions.serverRelevance: validation - client-side pre-check before firing a server use request
formulas: target type check: obj->vtbl(0xa8) must == 2 else reject
class match: actor-inventory obj->vtbl(0x88) == target obj->vtbl(0x88) required
functions.notes: ItemID -1 sentinel = no item bound.

functions.purpose: Registers pause/system-menu command handlers via CInfoRecord::GetModelString bindings: OnResumeGame, OnReturnChooseRole, OnReturnTown(+OK/Cancel), OnShowSystemSettingDlg, GPItemClickOpenInventory, GPItemClickOpenManufacture, OnExitGame, RequireExitGame, OnShowKeySettingDlg, OnShowWorldMap, OnResetPosclick, CheckIdelOrFallingState.
functions.notes: Item-relevant only for GPItemClickOpenInventory / GPItemClickOpenManufacture entry points.

functions.purpose: Registers system-bar hotkey/command handlers: SystemBar_PlayerPropertyUI, SystemBar_ShowQuestUI, SystemBar_ShowInventoryUI, SystemBar_ShowSysConfigUI, and single-key shows (T/O/K/H/M).
functions.notes: SystemBar_ShowInventoryUI opens the bag UI.

functions.purpose: Returns 1 only if the local player's current animation state name is NOT one of NORMAL_IDLE / NORMAL_RUN / NORMAL_IDLE_WARDROBE (i.e. player is busy), else 0; also requires wardrobe preconditions (FUN_10fd05d0, vtbl+0x7bc, FUN_10f5b910). Inline strcmp of the current anim state name.
formulas: returns 0 if anim-state == 'NORMAL_IDLE' or 'NORMAL_RUN' or 'NORMAL_IDLE_WARDROBE'; else 1 (with precondition checks)
functions.notes: Used to block wardrobe try-on while in a non-idle animation.

functions.purpose: CryEngine demo/game-state-recorder debug overlay renderer: draws the actor's recorded-vs-current inventory (item slots, ammo counts, accessories, ammo packs, firemode, health) using FUN_10b6ffa0 text draw. Pure diagnostic overlay ('demo_force_game_state'), highlights mismatches in red. Not gameplay logic.
formulas: column X positions 0x43960000(300f)/0x43c80000(400f)/0x44160000(600f) etc; row advance DAT_11cd7e88
ammo grid wraps every 5 columns (local_10 == (local_10/5)*5); accessory/ammo-pack iteration over red-black tree
costs: max name length copied: 0x1f (31) chars via strncpy
functions.notes: This 'Inventory' is the CryEngine actor equipment/ammo inventory, matching FUN_10a4fc50 family, not the MHO bag/store.
